svg.aria-label: How M1D0 works. 01. Understand the business: Its purpose and values, what it offers, whom it serves and how it operates. 02. Set the direction: Align expertise and resources to strengthen operations, decision-making, customer relationships and the capacity to adapt and grow. 03. Technology follows: Systems and capabilities selected to support the business's priorities, connecting people, processes, systems and information. 04. AI with clear purpose: AI and automation introduced only where they serve a clear business purpose, not as goals in themselves. Transform the Business. Architect the Technology. Harness AI with Purpose.
